lore-chord-stone.md.subject: Chord Stone
lore-chord-stone.md.statement: The chord stone erases the last hour from the memory of whoever carries it.
lore-chord-stone.md.quote: The chord stone erases the last hour from the memory of whoever carries it.

lore-chord-stone.md.subject: Chord Stone
lore-chord-stone.md.statement: The chord stone is kept in a lead-lined box in the Old Archive.
lore-chord-stone.md.quote: They keep it in a lead-lined box in the Old Archive.

lore-chord-stone.md.subject: Lighthouse
lore-chord-stone.md.statement: Walking from the Lighthouse to the Harbor takes about forty minutes.
lore-chord-stone.md.quote: The walk from the Lighthouse to the Harbor takes about forty minutes along the causeway.

characters.md.subject: Leya
characters.md.statement: Leya Venn is a cartographer's apprentice.
characters.md.quote: Leya Venn is a cartographer's apprentice who maps the shifting sandbanks around Solen.

characters.md.subject: Arin
characters.md.statement: Arin Venn is the keeper of the Solen Lighthouse.
characters.md.quote: Arin Venn is the keeper of the Solen Lighthouse.

characters.md.subject: Leya
characters.md.statement: Leya and Arin are biological siblings; Arin is four years older.
characters.md.quote: Leya and Arin are siblings, born to the same mother, and Arin is four years older.

characters.md.subject: Mara
characters.md.statement: Mara and Arin were engaged until Arin broke it off at 19:00 on Day 1.
characters.md.quote: Mara and Arin were engaged until the storm on the evening of Day 1, when Arin broke off the engagement at 19:00.

characters.md.subject: Mara
characters.md.statement: Mara Holt is a boat runner who trades at the Salt Market.
characters.md.quote: Mara Holt runs boats out of the Harbor and trades at the Salt Market.

characters.md.subject: Teodor
characters.md.statement: Teodor Brask is the last archivist of the Old Archive.
characters.md.quote: Teodor Brask is the last archivist of the Old Archive.

S01.md.subject: Leya
S01.md.statement: Leya is at the Harbor at 08:00 on Day 1.
S01.md.quote: At 08:00 on Day 1, Leya walks down to the Harbor with her sounding line and a fresh sheet of vellum.

S02.md.subject: Mara
S02.md.quote: "You're my sister in all but blood," Mara says, and Leya laughs.

S03.md.subject: Mara
S03.md.statement: Mara is at the Harbor at 12:30 on Day 2.
S03.md.quote: At 12:30 on Day 2, Mara is at the Harbor, unloading crates that do not appear on any manifest.

S04.md.subject: Leya
S04.md.statement: Leya is in the Old Archive from 13:00 to 14:00 on Day 1.
S04.md.quote: At 13:00 on Day 1, Leya enters the Old Archive looking for an older chart of the sandbanks.

S04.md.subject: Leya
S04.md.statement: Leya holds the chord stone with her bare hands for about an hour on Day 1.
S04.md.quote: Leya picks up the chord stone with her bare hands and turns it toward the window.

S05.md.subject: Arin
S05.md.statement: Arin is crossing the causeway at 22:00 on Day 1.
S05.md.quote: At 22:00 on Day 1, Arin is crossing the causeway on foot, lantern shuttered against the wind.

S06.md.subject: Arin
S06.md.statement: Arin stays in the Lighthouse gallery from 21:30 to 22:30 on Day 1.
S06.md.quote: From 21:30 to 22:30 on Day 1, Arin keeps the lamp lit at the Lighthouse and never leaves the gallery.

S06.md.subject: Arin
S06.md.statement: Arin signals Mara's boat three times with the lamp.
S06.md.quote: Arin flashes the lamp three times for Mara's boat.

S07.md.subject: Arin
S07.md.statement: Arin carries the chord stone in a leather pouch overnight on Day 2.
S07.md.quote: On the night of Day 2, Arin carries the chord stone in a leather pouch from the Old Archive to the Lighthouse.

S07.md.subject: Arin
S07.md.statement: Arin still remembers the whole night walk at dawn on Day 3.
S07.md.quote: At dawn on Day 3 he still remembers every step of the walk, and that frightens him more than forgetting would.

S08.md.subject: Mara
S08.md.statement: Mara is at the Salt Market around midday on Day 2.
S08.md.quote: Around midday on Day 2, Mara is at the Salt Market, haggling over the price of a broken compass.

S09.md.subject: Leya
S09.md.statement: Leya has no memory of 13:00–14:00 on Day 1, attributed to the chord stone.
S09.md.quote: Leya cannot remember anything between 13:00 and 14:00 on Day 1. Arin tells her it was the chord stone.

S10.md.subject: Mara
S10.md.statement: Arin is Mara's fiancé at 10:00 on Day 3.
S10.md.quote: Mara's fiancé, Arin, opens the door at 10:00 on Day 3 and hands over the leather pouch.

S10.md.subject: Arin
S10.md.statement: Arin is at the Lighthouse at 10:00 on Day 3.
S10.md.quote: Mara's fiancé, Arin, opens the door at 10:00 on Day 3 and hands over the leather pouch.

S10.md.subject: Teodor
S10.md.statement: Teodor briefly presses the chord stone to Arin's hand so he forgets the night.
S10.md.quote: Teodor presses the chord stone briefly to the back of Arin's hand, so that he will forget the night.

S11.md.subject: Arin
S11.md.statement: Arin rings the harbor bell at the Harbor at 10:15 on Day 3.
S11.md.quote: At 10:15 on Day 3, Arin rings the harbor bell at the Harbor to call the boats in.
